t: This augment can only be added to a $(l:modules/vacuum)Vacuum Module/$.$(p)When this augment is added, the Vacuum Module will absorb experience orbs instead of items. The orbs will be converted into $(item)Bottles o' Enchanting/$ at the rate of 7XP per bottle (which is the average amount of XP gained by breaking a Bottle o' Enchanting).
这个增强件只能添加到$(l:modules/vacuum)虚空模块/$。$(p)添加该增强件后，虚空模块吸收的将不再是物品，而是经验球。经验球会按每瓶 7XP 的比例转换成$(item)附魔之瓶/$（这正是打碎一瓶附魔之瓶平均获得的经验值）。

Depending on what other mods are installed, it might also be possible to convert orbs into XP fluids. This requires that either a fluid-containing tank is in the router's buffer, or adjacent to the router. In the latter case, ensure that the $(bold)Eject/$ button is enabled in the Vacuum Module's GUI.
根据安装的其他模组不同，也可能可以将经验球转换为经验流体。这要求路由器缓冲区中有一个含流体的储罐物品，或者该储罐与路由器相邻。若是后一种情况，请确保虚空模块 GUI 中的$(bold)弹出/$按钮已启用。
